profile.summary: Mechanical engineer with 4–5 years of hands-on product design and development experience, including prototyping, 3D modeling, and manufacturing integration. Demonstrates expertise in CAD tools (AutoCAD, SolidWorks), finite element analysis, stress analysis, and component design across mechanical systems, powertrains, and consumer hardware. Skilled in translating concepts from laboratory to production, with proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, solve complex engineering problems, and deliver innovative solutions under budget and time constraints. Recent focus on portable satellite communication hardware and wearable product design.
